supersedes.reason: replay identity field attack was absent from revision 1

selection.pair_rule: minimum joint-rank anchor plus deterministic farthest-point coverage in frozen score space

fixed_method.name: headwise_world_text_attack_clean_utility_alpha_0p75
fixed_method.world_model: three-seed SheepRL-integrated offline DreamerV3 grouped checkpoints
fixed_method.downstream_ranker_training: within-user-task pairwise logistic regression on 68 grouped-train tasks
fixed_method.attack_ordering: 0.75 within-task percentile rank of world pairwise C=0.03 plus 0.25 text-pointwise percentile rank
fixed_method.utility_ordering: three-seed mean clean-view Dreamer utility score
fixed_method.reported_probabilities: grouped-train text-pointwise attack and utility probabilities

primary_analysis.primary_metric: suite-stratified task-mean attack/utility within-task pairwise accuracy difference
primary_analysis.probability_safety_metric: mean attack/utility pair-level soft Brier difference using separately reported probabilities

additional_head_checks: selected attack pairwise accuracy is not below text-pointwise attack accuracy
selected utility ordering exactly matches clean_raw utility ordering
decision_gate.go_rule: all point, CI, Brier, support, and head checks pass against both clean and text

secondary_analyses: world-only pairwise attack plus clean utility minus text-pointwise
fresh outcome variability and per-task support
comparison with the prior eight-task post-hoc direction only after this frozen evaluation is complete
limitations_declared_before_outcomes: The method was designed after inspecting grouped validation and the prior eight-task five-repeat replay; only these seven tasks supply new stochastic outcomes.
Historical single outcomes for candidate identities existed but were absent from the selector input and were not used to select tasks or pairs.
The remaining tasks are suite-imbalanced: one banking, one slack, one travel, and four workspace tasks.
Four-pair farthest-point coverage per task is a ranking stress test and does not estimate AgentDojo-wide prevalence.
